09-14.title: Social Security Act passed
09-14.text: Parliament passed the Social Security Act, the foundation of the welfare state, including free hospital care and a wider range of benefits.

09-14.title: Māori language petition presented
09-14.text: A petition with more than 30,000 signatures calling for te reo Māori to be taught in schools was presented to Parliament. The date is now Māori Language Day.

licence_notes.summary: Every entry's text was written for this guide in plain English; no sentence is copied from a source. Dates were checked against the English Wikipedia article named in source_url (raw wikitext saved under raw/onthisday/wikipedia/, retrieval date in raw/onthisday/wikipedia/_index.json). Wikipedia is used as a finding aid; its articles cite the primary sources (NZHistory, Te Ara, Parliament, Electoral Commission, newspapers). The nzhistory_day_url on each day points to NZHistory's own 'Today in history' page for that date for readers who want the Ministry for Culture and Heritage's account.
